tldr: Sun through the 1st house brings focus to self, body, identity, and first moves.
body: Sun transiting the 1st house illuminates self, body, identity, and first moves. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports personal presence: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or over-identifying with the moment.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 1st house deliberately. Work with self, body, identity, and first moves without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
